cues.text: A golden chamber. The team stands on its patterned floor.
A dark silhouette rises before them, hunched over.
It lifts a hand. It has the hero's face, its eyes glowing red.
The face turns pale blue, like a mask.
Blue light spreads up its arm, and it breaks apart into glowing dust.
The light climbs its whole body. Butterflies circle it.
Wrapped in blue flame, the figure stands still.
The figure is gone. Blue butterflies drift up into the golden light.
Koromaru, Junpei, Ken and Fuuka watch.
Aigis lowers her hand. A blue butterfly rises past her.
It flutters away into the golden light, and fades.
